paite: Darias akum nihna, akha giatna in, iddo tapa, Berekiah tapa, Zekariah, zawlnei kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a,
heading: TOUPA'N Amite Kik Nawn Ding In Asam
english: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, Yahweh’s word came to the prophet Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, saying,

paite: "Na pipute uh tung ah TOUPA nakpitak in alungkim kei hi," chi in.
english: “Yahweh was very displeased with your fathers.

paite: Huaiziak in nang akiang uah, huchibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: "Ka kiang ah hong kik un, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi, huan na kiang uah ka hong kik ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi," chi in.
english: Therefore tell them, Yahweh of Armies says: ‘Return to me,’ says Yahweh of Armies, ‘and I will return to you,’ says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi, "Tu in na omdan gilou ua kipan leh na thilhih giloute ua kipan hong kik un," chi a zawlnei masate'n agenna uh, na pipute uh bang in om kei un; himahleh amau hon za kei ua, hon ngaikhe sam kei uh, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: Don’t you be like your fathers, to whom the former prophets proclaimed, saying: Yahweh of Armies says, ‘Return now from your evil ways and from your evil doings;’ but they didn’t hear nor listen to me, says Yahweh.

paite: Na pipute uh tua koi a omta ahi ua? Huan azawlneite uh tangtawn in ahing uhia?
english: Your fathers, where are they? And the prophets, do they live forever?

paite: Himahleh ka thute leh ka dan thusehte, ka sikha zawlneite thupiak a ka piakte, huaite'n na pipute uh delhphata uh ahi kei maw? Huan akihei ua, "Sepaihte' TOUPA'N i tung ua hih dia angaihtuah bang in, i omdan bang zel in leh i thilhihte bang zel a i tung ua hih ahita ve," achi uhi.
english: But my words and my decrees, which I commanded my servants the prophets, didn’t they overtake your fathers? “Then they repented and said, ‘Just as Yahweh of Armies determined to do to us, according to our ways and according to our practices, so he has dealt with us.’”

paite: Darias akum nihna, Sebat kha, akha sawm-le-khat, ani sawmnih-le-li ni in, Iddo tapa, Berekiah tapa Zekariah, zawlnei kiang ah, TOUPA thu ahong tung a,
heading: Zekariah In Sakolte Muhna
english: On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, which is the month Shebat, in the second year of Darius, Yahweh’s word came to the prophet Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, saying,

paite: "Zan in mengmuhna in mi khat sakol san tung a tuang, munliap a om muisingte lak a dingh ka mu a, anunglam ah sakolte a-om ua, asan, asanpuang leh angou ahi uhi.
english: “I had a vision in the night, and behold, a man riding on a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle trees that were in a ravine; and behind him there were red, brown, and white horses.

paite: Huchi in 'Aw ka toupa, hiaite bang ahi ua?' ka chi a, huan kei hon houpih angel in ka kiang ah, ‘Hiaite bang ahi ua ka hon ensak ding,' achi hi.
english: Then I asked, ‘My lord, what are these?’” The angel who talked with me said to me, “I will show you what these are.”

paite: Huai muising lak a dingpa'n adawng a, 'Hiaite leitung a kivialleh a vak dia TOUPA'N asawlte ahi uh,' achi hi.
english: The man who stood among the myrtle trees answered, “They are the ones Yahweh has sent to go back and forth through the earth.”

paite: "Huchi in huai muising lak a dingh TOUPA angel adawng ua, 'Leitung ah kivialleh in ka vakta ua, ngai in, leitung tengteng atu kinken a, akhawl dide hi,' " achi uhi.
english: They reported to Yahweh’s angel who stood among the myrtle trees, and said, “We have walked back and forth through the earth, and behold, all the earth is at rest and in peace.”

paite: Huan TOUPA angel in adawng a, "Aw sepaihte' TOUPA, hiai kum sawmsagih na hehkhum, Jerusalem tung leh Judah khopite tung ah bang tan zahngaihna nei lou ding na hia?" achi hi.
english: Then Yahweh’s angel replied, “O Yahweh of Armies, how long will you not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah, against which you have had indignation these seventy years?”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N thuhoihte, thu lungmuanhuaite a kei hon houpih angel adawng hi.
english: Yahweh answered the angel who talked with me with kind and comforting words.

paite: Huchi in kei hon houpih angel in ka kiang ah, hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: "Thikthu setak in Jerusalem leh Zion ka deihthoh ahi, chi in nang kikou in, chi in.
english: So the angel who talked with me said to me, “Proclaim, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies says: “I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy.

paite: Huan bangmah awlmoh lou namte tung ah ka lungkim kei ding a; neukha lel a ka lung hih louh lai in, siatna athupisak semsem uhi.
english: I am very angry with the nations that are at ease; for I was but a little displeased, but they added to the calamity.”

paite: Huaiziak in hichibang in TOUPA'N achi: Zahngaihnate toh Jerusalem ah ka kik nawnta a, asung ah inn lam ahi ding," chi in.
english: Therefore Yahweh says: “I have returned to Jerusalem with mercy. My house shall be built in it,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and a line shall be stretched out over Jerusalem.”’

paite: Hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: "Hauhsakna ziak in ka khopite akiphalh ding a; TOUPA'N Zion alungmuan in, Jerusalem atel lai ding hi, chi in kikou behlap lai in," chi in.
english: “Proclaim further, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies says: “My cities will again overflow with prosperity, and Yahweh will again comfort Zion, and will again choose Jerusalem.”’”

paite: Huan ka dak a, ngai in kii li ka mu hi.
heading: Kite Leh Siksekmi Muhna
english: I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, four horns.

paite: Kei hon houpih angel kiang ah, "Hiaite bang hi ding ahia?" ka chi a. Ama'n, "Hiaite Judah, Israel leh Jerusalem hawlzak mite ahi uh," chi in ahon dawng hi.
english: I asked the angel who talked with me, “What are these?” He answered me, “These are the horns which have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'n siksekmi li ahon ensak hi.
english: Yahweh showed me four craftsmen.

paite: Huchi in ke'n, "Bang hih dia hiaite hong uh ahi ua?" ka chi hi. Ama'n thu agen a, "Kuamah in alu adaksaklouhna dia, Judah dalhzaksak hiai kiite ahi uh; himahleh hiaite, dalhzaksak ding a Judah gam tung a akii uh sangsak namte dou ding leh akiite uh paikhe ding a hong paite ahi uh," achi hi.
english: Then I asked, “What are these coming to do?” He said, “These are the horns which scattered Judah, so that no man lifted up his head; but these have come to terrify them, to cast down the horns of the nations that lifted up their horn against the land of Judah to scatter it.”
